blackbox — X11 Window Manager (bbidulock/blackboxwm 0.77)
Upstream:  https://github.com/bbidulock/blackboxwm/releases/tag/0.77
License:   MIT (COPYING in the extracted tree)

The GitHub release tarball ships the full source tree (src/, lib/, data/,
util/, doc/, po/). Our overlay supplies:

  config.h
      Replaces the autoheader-produced config.h. Disables SHAPE, MITSHM,
      XFT, NLS, and WITH_FULLSCREEN — features that either pull in em-x11
      gaps (SHAPE's XShapeCombineShape, MIT-SHM's shared memory) or are
      irrelevant in a browser (NLS, fullscreen toggle).

  version.h (generated/)
      Replaces AC_CONFIG_FILES([version.h]). Hardcodes __blackbox_version
      to "0.77" instead of going through autoconf substitution.

No SM/ICE stubs needed — blackbox does not use X Session Management.
